caption: The drawing depicts a single, lidded glass goblet positioned centrally on a blank background. The glass goblet has a rounded bowl, a short stem, and a circular, flared base. Resting on top of the bowl is a matching lid with a small, rounded knob handle at its center. The surface of both the bowl and the lid is decorated with finely detailed etchings, featuring floral motifs such as flowers with radiating petals and leaves. The drawing is rendered in grayscale, giving the appearance of a pencil or graphite medium, utilizing shading and highlights to create a sense of depth and the reflective quality of glass. The background is plain with an off-white or cream color, and the artist’s name, "John Dana," is noted in a small, light script at the bottom left corner.
title: Sugar Bowl
